image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a wombat emerging from a dark burrow entrance. The animal has coarse, grey-brown fur and a stocky, barrel-shaped body. Its head is broad with small eyes and rounded ears. The nose appears large and dark. The foreground consists of dirt, dry leaves, and twigs. The background is the shadowed interior of the burrow and rocky earth.
